title: potentilla alpestris var. sabauda
intro: Potentilla alpestris var. sabauda, commonly known as Alpine Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species within the Rosaceae family, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Potentilla alpestris var. sabauda include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla alpestris var. sabauda have been found to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal value.
